name: print-social-poster-collage-navy-orange-reading-quotes
title: Navy/orange collage poster with reading quote cards
whatItIs: A dense collage-style poster mixing navy and orange quote cards, book illustrations and hand-drawn accents, centered on a large open-book illustration and bold mixed-case headline about reading.
whatItMeans: A magazine-style collage of many small text/image cards around one dominant illustration mimics an editorial spread, giving a single static poster the density and browsability of a full page.
techniques: arrange many small mismatched quote/text cards in a dense grid around one dominant illustration
alternate card background colors (navy/orange/cream) for rhythm across a busy grid
use a mix of serif, script and hand-lettered type across cards to feel curated rather than templated
bestFor: book club or reading initiative graphics

vocabulary.definition: a composition assembling many smaller distinct elements into one dense unified whole
